description.value: Honolulu Coffee is a Hawaii-origin specialty coffee chain bringing farm-to-cup Kona coffee to its café locations, including this spot in downtown Vancouver. The brand sources its beans from its own Kona farm on the Big Island and emphasizes single-origin quality. Touring cyclists passing through the Nelson Street corridor will find indoor and outdoor seating and vegetarian-friendly options.
